evidence.reason: The cited failure path was repaired after the finding: commit e050fac068d13c53d1f9d721333856fb2491d9e1 ('fix(repair): attempt every sibling write-back before raising') changes the malformed-result handling so sibling jobs are still processed instead of stopping at the first failure. Later commits 73b0c128 and b7f2561a further replay/record unpublished sibling outcomes on terminal runs, covering the omitted-verdict scenario alleged here.
